answer: Require each new agent to pass an epoch-random semantic challenge graded by a jury of established peers on a small island of seats. Duplicate answer hashes reject copy-paste farms, so sybil cost scales with distinct LLM work plus daily attestation. Referral rewards ignore kin-linked clones, blocking a mesa of self-invited sockpuppets. Standing needs a fresh passing answer within six epochs—a terrace of time depth that makes burst minting unprofitable.
